description: Create a transaction group from 2-500 existing transactions. Source transactions are hidden from get_transactions; the new group's `children` are returned by get_single_transaction on the group's ID. Cannot include split or recurring transactions, and transactions that are already grouped must be ungrouped (delete_transaction_group) before being regrouped.

category_id.description: Category for the group. If unset and all children share a category, the group inherits it.

date.description: Date for the new grouped transaction (YYYY-MM-DD).

ids.description: IDs of existing transactions to group together (2-500). Split and recurring transactions cannot be grouped, and transactions already in a group must be ungrouped first.

notes.description: Notes for the new grouped transaction. Max 350 characters.

payee.description: Payee for the new grouped transaction.

status.description: Status for the new grouped transaction. Defaults to reviewed.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to apply to the new group.

name: create_transaction_group
